meta.name: Send invoice follow-ups, escalations, and weekly digests with Google Sheets and Gmail

name: Automate Invoice Follow-Ups With Overdue Escalations And Payment Digest

parameters.content:
## Automate Invoice Follow-Ups With Overdue Escalations And Payment Digest

### How it works

This workflow helps freelancers, agencies, and small finance teams follow up unpaid invoices without manually checking a spreadsheet every day. It reads invoice records from Google Sheets, calculates due and overdue status, decides the correct follow-up stage, sends polite customer reminders, logs each reminder, escalates seriously overdue invoices to the finance owner, and sends a weekly receivables digest.

### Setup steps

- Create a Google Sheet with `Invoices`, `Reminder Log`, and `Escalation Log` tabs.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials in every Google Sheets node.
- Connect Gmail credentials in every Gmail node.
- Replace the placeholder Google Sheet ID in all Sheets nodes.
- Replace sender-facing finance email addresses and internal alert recipients.
- Review the reminder schedule, overdue thresholds, and message copy.
- Test with sample invoices before activating the workflow.

### Customization

Adjust reminder thresholds, escalation rules, customer email copy, currency formatting, and digest timing to match your payment policy.

## Start daily invoice review

The schedule trigger runs every morning and reads unpaid invoice records from the `Invoices` tab.

The workflow expects each invoice row to include client contact details, amount, due date, status, and last reminder information.

## Calculate follow-up stage

The Code node reviews each unpaid invoice and decides whether it needs action today.

It calculates days until due, days overdue, reminder stage, escalation status, customer email subject, customer email body, and internal recommended action.

## Send reminder and log activity

Invoices that need customer follow-up are sent through Gmail.

Each reminder is appended to the `Reminder Log` tab so the team can see when a client was contacted and which stage was used.

## Escalate high-risk invoices

Invoices that are seriously overdue, high value, or repeatedly followed up are routed to the escalation path.

The workflow creates an escalation log entry and emails the finance owner with invoice details, delay age, reminder history, and recommended next action.

## Start weekly digest

Runs every Monday morning and reads open invoices from Google Sheets for a receivables summary.

## Build payment digest

The summary node groups unpaid invoices by current, due soon, overdue, and escalated amounts.

It creates a short finance digest for weekly review.

## Email weekly summary

Sends the receivables digest to the finance owner so unpaid invoice risk is visible without opening the spreadsheet.

## Google Sheets setup

`Invoices`: Invoice ID | Client Name | Client Email | Amount | Currency | Due Date | Status | Last Reminder Date | Reminder Count | Owner | Notes

`Reminder Log`: Logged At | Invoice ID | Client Name | Client Email | Reminder Stage | Days Overdue | Amount | Subject | Recommended Action

`Escalation Log`: Logged At | Invoice ID | Client Name | Client Email | Amount | Days Overdue | Reminder Count | Reason | Owner | Status
